text:
olga_am: Skyline Med (SM-58) disputed INV-2026-06. They show two reserved commit lines for the same hour after a canary rollout. Posting invoice excerpt.

olga_am: Invoice excerpt:
```
INV-2026-06 | SM-58 | Reserved Commit (monthly) | $9,000.00
INV-2026-06 | SM-58-canary | Reserved Commit (alloc 40%) | $3,600.00
INV-2026-06 | SM-58-prod   | Reserved Commit (alloc 60%) | $5,400.00
INV-2026-06 | SM-58-canary | Reserved Commit (alloc 40%) | $3,600.00  <-- duplicate
```

olga_am: They want a corrected invoice + explanation.

ben_ops: Ran quick checks. `alloc-inspect --acct SM-58 --period 2026-06-10` shows a tag propagation race during canary -> canary tag was applied and then retried, producing duplicate allocation rows even though tokens consumed remain within monthly commit.

ben_ops: Short log excerpt:
```
2026-06-10T08:58Z canary:tag applied -> tags=[sm:prod, sm:canary]
2026-06-10T09:01Z canary:retry -> tagset duplicated
```

sara_billing: Proposed provisional corrections:
- Remove duplicate reserved line = -$3,600
- SLA credit for 18m latency spike = 3% of committed ($9,000) = -$270
- Small goodwill credit = -$130
Provisional total = -$4,000.

henry_fin: I can approve up to $4,100 provisional to speed response. Create FIN-7950 to track. Finance requires infra backfill ticket before final accounting adjustments.

olga_am: Draft reply: "Thanks — we found a tagging race during your canary rollout that created a duplicate reserved allocation line. We will issue a provisional $4,000 credit and send a corrected invoice after we backfill meter records. This is a one-time correction; ETA 48 business hours." OK to send?

sara_billing: Send it. I'll BCC legal on the corrected invoice template.

leo_infra: Opening INFRA-54890 to patch tag retrier and run backfill for 2026-06-10. Action items: fix retrier dedupe, re-run allocation backfill for SM-58, stage corrected invoice. ETA 36h.

billing-bot: Metering alert: `duplicate-allocation-detected` SM-58 2026-06-10T09:01Z.

henry_fin: FIN-7950 created and provisionally approved. Finalize after INFRA-54890 backfill and AM signoff.

olga_am: Customer replied acknowledging provisional credit; we'll close once corrected invoice is issued. :white_check_mark:
